name: Koi Tsuma Kuzushi
source:
She had been raised lovingly, and was loved in marriage.
She might have remained childishly naive forever.
But it was not to be.

An ADV of humiliation told from the wife's point of view.
Also experience it from the husband's point of view.
Her demolished spirit and body, slowly, day by day. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE093972.html]DLsite english[/url]]
translation:
她被爱意抚养长大，在婚姻中被爱着。她本可以永远保持天真幼稚。但事实并非如此。

一部从妻子视角讲述的凌辱ADV。也可以从丈夫的视角体验。她的精神和肉体被一点点地、日复一日地摧毁。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE093972.html]DLsite English[/url]]
